notes: All figures from the 2024 Annual Report on HKEXnews. Two employee bases overlap and are kept under separate metrics: the MD&A says 41,492 full-time employees were in mainland China, while the ESG table counts 41,643 in 'Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan' (the report names these four, so that region carries a country list). India is named as the main location outside mainland China but no number is given; Africa and Oceania (0) are omitted. Retail store count is 'nearly 15,000' (approximate). The EV factory's city is not stated in the report, so it has no place. No U.S. state data.
